title: Refactor PHP Codebase
problem_statement: The PHP codebase lacks adherence to modern coding standards.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased maintenance burden and potential security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Refactor the PHP code to comply with PSR-12 standards and improve error handling.
success_criteria: Improved error handling and logging mechanisms in place.

title: Secure SQL Queries
problem_statement: SQL queries are not parameterized, posing a security risk.
risk_if_unaddressed: High risk of SQL injection attacks.
suggested_approach: Parameterize all SQL queries to prevent SQL injection.
